messages.subject: CPD seminar: Limiting liability in technology contracts (16 Dec)
messages.plaintextBody: Join us for a lunchtime CPD seminar on drafting and negotiating limitation-of-liability clauses in SaaS and technology agreements. 12:30–13:30 on 16 December, Training Room 2, sandwiches provided. 1 CPD hour. RSVP to Knowledge & Learning.
